howto.what: 装上后，当你提交代码或创建Pull Request时，Claude会严格按照Conventional Commits格式生成提交信息，包括类型、作用域和描述，并应用提交最佳实践（如每提交一个逻辑变更、引用issue号）。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude帮助提交代码、创建Pull Request，或者需要编写git commit消息时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这次改动写成规范commit，类型是feat，作用域是suite。
say.note: Claude会按格式生成提交信息。

say.text: 为我创建一个Pull Request描述，参考项目模板。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude strictly follows Conventional Commits format (type, scope, description) for git commits and applies best practices like one logical change per commit and referencing issue numbers, especially when committing code or creating pull requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to help with code commits, create pull requests, or write git commit messages.

say_en.text: Write a commit for this change, type feat, scope suite.
say_en.note: Claude generates a formatted commit message.

say_en.text: Create a pull request description using the project template.
How should I write a commit for this code? Use Conventional Commits.
